Hero.name: Silas Ribeiro dos Santos
Hero.tagline: I build corporate systems, APIs, and robust web applications, combining analytical thinking with strong software engineering practices.

About.title: About me
About.subtitle: A mathematician by training, a software engineer by choice.
About.bio: I'm a Computer Networks Technician, graduated in Mathematics, and hold a postgraduate degree in Software Engineering, working in full-stack development for several years. Throughout my career, I've contributed to corporate systems across segments like food delivery, payroll-deductible credit, and booking platforms, working with technologies such as Vue.js, Angular, Java, Spring Boot, Python, and Django. I currently work as an Analyst Developer II at Qintess, contributing to systems used by Brazil's Ministry of Justice. I have a strong interest in software architecture, Clean Code, and Design Patterns, and I use tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude Code daily to ship better code, faster, without compromising quality.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.subtitle: A selection of real systems I built end to end, from briefing to production.

items.name: ProspecMan
items.tagline: Turns a client briefing into a full project package with AI
items.description: A tool that takes a client briefing as audio or text and generates a complete project package — architecture, stack, phased schedule, and a suggested price — ready to open in VS Code. Available as a CLI, API, and mobile and web apps.
highlights: Audio transcription with Whisper (Groq) and image analysis with Claude Vision
Structured AI-generated plan, validated as JSON with Pydantic
Deterministic pricing based on estimated hours and hourly rate
In real use: API running in production on Render, Android app used daily

items.name: Rotineira
items.tagline: AI-powered mobile app for weekly family meal planning
items.description: A mobile app that uses AI to plan weekly meal-prep menus, calculating each family member's exact portion and building a shopping list that treats the weekly budget as a hard limit.
highlights: Menu generation with Gemini 2.5 Flash, focused on freezable meals
Per-member family profiles (appetite, dietary restrictions, calorie limits)
Shopping list consolidated by category, with price estimates
Free and Premium plans managed through RevenueCat

items.name: Núcleo Estar Bem
items.tagline: Room-booking system for a psychology clinic
items.description: A booking system for a coworking clinic where psychologists rent consultation rooms by the hour, replacing manual scheduling with real-time availability and occupancy reports.
highlights: Admin-created time blocks and automatic no-show detection
Weekly and monthly occupancy reports exported as PDF
Automatic reminders via WhatsApp (Baileys) and emails via SendGrid
In production: Next.js frontend on Vercel, Fastify API on Railway

items.name: Magnus Imóveis
items.tagline: Full real estate platform for a Belo Horizonte agency
items.description: A real estate platform that replaced a paid third-party system with an in-house public site and admin panel, with no frontend framework at all.
highlights: Property search and filters, SAC financing simulator, and visit scheduling
Lead capture with round-robin assignment across brokers
Installable admin panel (PWA) with property CRUD and PDF catalog export
Falls back to WhatsApp if the database write fails, so no lead is lost

items.name: MaPinha
items.tagline: Gamified interactive map for personal points of interest
items.description: An interactive map for marking and sharing personal points of interest — from a favorite bar to a go-to restaurant — with four visual themes and real-time route calculation.
highlights: PWA with offline map caching and clustered search
Public sharing with Open Graph and server-rendered pages
Three Claude-based AI agents for categorization, description, and recommendations
In production: frontend on Vercel, FastAPI backend on Render
